notes: After captions are placed, the playhead goes back to where you left it instead of the end of the video.
Warning and error windows from Resolve look like the rest of Srutilekha.
Save SRT on the done screen saves the captions this run placed as an .srt file.
When a run pauses, Srutilekha shows a calm heading, what to do next, and the details folded away.
